attempts.change: Replace blocking GIoU box assertions with asynchronous device assertions, preserving validity checks without 24 host synchronizations per step.
Use bfloat16 autocast for model forward and float32 for Hungarian matching and losses; backward remains outside autocast.
Pack Hungarian assignment indices and transfer once to the prediction device, eliminating repeated implicit CPU-index transfers during criterion indexing.
Compile the ResNet backbone in place with dynamic shapes to fuse normalization/elementwise kernels while preserving model and checkpoint structure.
Use fused CUDA AdamW to reduce optimizer kernel launches without changing optimizer settings or parameter groups.
